title: Aloha Spirits brewery liquor license and zoning limits
summary: The commission accepted the Aloha Spirits Brewing and Distilling liquor license application on September 9, but staff said the Planning Department has raised new zoning questions about the applicant's planned uses. The department is awaiting written confirmation of what the brewery may do at its location, and zoning may not allow selling kegs or cases to stores, restaurants or bars. No license will be issued until the zoning clearance requirement is met.

timeline.text: New liquor license application number seven (Aloha Spirits Brewing and Distilling): The commission accepted the Aloha Spirits Brewing and Distilling application, with zoning among the requirements still to be met.
A motion to go into executive session (a closed-door discussion) about county liability failed, four to three.
Staff said zoning may not let a brewery pub applicant sell beer directly to wholesalers, restaurants or stores.
No liquor license will be issued to the brewery until it meets the zoning clearance requirement.
